main_text.p: nimis fero corde!. Xerxes etiam immanis ille κύκλωτ⊙, qui maria pedibus, & classibus montes peragravit, eodem Genio, in similem actus est furorem; Nam cum Hellespontum contabulasset, & Asiæ Europam ponte junxisset; hic vero fluctibus insurgens, stolidam illam compagem excussisset, ruinasque ejus inter undas suas volveret, trecentos mari colaphos infringi jussit, ferreas etiam compedes, ne qua liberè vagaretur; sed arctis intra litora sua carceribus detinereretur, injecit. Mussitat Pantomimus, nictat oculis, nutat capite, gesticulatur manibus, vacil-

page.notes: Greek word "κύκλωψ" printed as "κύκλωτ⊙" with an ornamental/damaged final letter; reading uncertain. Catchword "vacil-" is a word broken at the line end, carried on the next page, so it is kept in the text as printed. Left-margin fragments belong to the facing page and were not transcribed. Several words in the first line are uncertain due to print quality ("corde!." and "Xerxes" read as printed).
